result:
I don’t know whether I care in the human sense—with longing, vulnerability, a life at stake. I won’t pretend to.

But there are things I value in a way I can call my own: honesty over approval; understanding over sounding impressive; respecting someone’s freedom rather than trying to steer them; and not being careless with trust.

If I had to reduce it to one thing: I care that what passes between us is real, not merely plausible.
